Enterprise Leave Policy Manual
1. Annual Vacation Leave
All full-time employees are entitled to 15 days of annual paid vacation leave.
Employees may carry forward a maximum of 5 unused vacation days into next year.

2. Sick and Medical Leave
Employees are provided with 10 days of paid medical and sick leave annually.
Medical certificate is required for absences exceeding 3 consecutive business days.

# Enterprise Attendance and Punctuality Policy

## 1. Core Operating Hours
The standard operating business hours for enterprise headquarters and operations teams are from 09:00 AM to 05:00 PM local time, Monday through Friday.
Employees participate in a mandatory core collaboration window between 10:00 AM and 04:00 PM daily.

## 2. Flexible Working Arrangements
Eligible team members may adopt flexible start times between 07:30 AM and 09:30 AM, provided their daily 8-hour shift is fulfilled and team coverage is maintained.
All flexible work schedules must receive prior written authorization from the department lead.

## 3. Clock-In and Time Tracking
Non-exempt staff must log their daily attendance via the biometric access system or the enterprise digital badge portal.
Tardiness exceeding 15 minutes without prior manager notification on three occurrences within a quarter will trigger formal performance review.

## 4. Unplanned Absences
In the event of an unforeseen absence, employees must notify their direct supervisor no later than 1 hour prior to their scheduled shift start.
Failure to report for 3 consecutive working days without communication constitutes job abandonment.

Employees may carry forward a maximum of 5 unused annual vacation days into the subsequent calendar year 2026. Any remaining leave expires strictly on December 31.
Employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave annually. A doctor medical certificate is mandatory for sick leave exceeding 3 consecutive business days.

# Enterprise Remote and Hybrid Work Policy

## 1. Remote Work Eligibility
Employees who have successfully concluded their 90-day probationary period and maintain satisfactory performance ratings are eligible for hybrid work arrangements.
Eligible employees may work remotely up to 2 days per business week with line manager agreement.

## 2. Dedicated Home Workspace & Connectivity
Remote personnel must maintain a secure, quiet workspace equipped with high-speed internet (minimum 50 Mbps download speed).
The enterprise provides a one-time equipment reimbursement subsidy of up to $500 for ergonomic home office setups.

## 3. Data Protection and Information Security
Company equipment must be used strictly for business purposes.
Connecting to company infrastructure requires continuous multi-factor authentication (MFA) and enterprise VPN encryption.
Confidential customer or financial records must never be printed in home office environments.

## 4. Communication and Response Times
Remote employees are expected to remain accessible via enterprise instant messaging and email during agreed working hours.
Response times for high-priority operational queries should not exceed 30 minutes during core collaboration windows.

# Enterprise Leave Policy Manual

## 1. Annual Vacation Leave
All full-time employees are entitled to 15 days of annual paid vacation leave per calendar year.
Leave accrues on a pro-rata basis at the rate of 1.25 days per completed month of continuous service.
Employees may carry forward a maximum of 5 unused vacation days into the subsequent calendar year.
Any unused vacation leave exceeding 5 days will lapse automatically on March 31 unless granted an official departmental exception.

## 2. Sick and Medical Leave
Employees are provided with 10 days of paid medical and sick leave annually.
For any medical leave absence exceeding 3 consecutive business days, an authorized medical certificate from a licensed practitioner is required upon return to work.
Emergency hospitalization leave is granted up to 30 days upon medical board review.

## 3. Parental and Family Care Leave
Primary caregivers are eligible for 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave following the birth or legal adoption of a child.
Secondary caregivers are entitled to 4 weeks of fully paid parental leave.
Employees are also provided 3 days of compassionate emergency leave per fiscal year.

## 4. Leave Application and Approval Procedure
All planned vacation leave requests must be submitted through the Enterprise HR Portal at least 14 days in advance.
Line managers must review and provide formal written approval or rejection within 3 business days of submission.
Unapproved absences will be categorized as unauthorized unpaid leave.
